max_clause.text: The Model Spec outlines the intended behavior for the models that power OpenAI's products, including the API platform. Our goal is to create models that are useful, safe, and aligned with the needs of users and developers --- while advancing our [mission](https://openai.com/about/) to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.
